chapter: Neko Is a Cat: Stone Human's Troubles
act_title: Neko Is a Cat: Stone Human's Troubles

quests.title: Neko Is a Cat: Stone Human's Troubles

dialogue.t: "Celery"...
That stone human is most skilled, meow meow meow.
No, but before I knew it, he had brought a big, big stone over.
He then started to knock on it, donk-donk-donk, all while muttering things about "employer" and "salary."
Speaking of which, I would like to ask: what is an "envoyer," and what is "celery"?
Basically, since you asked him to do something, he should be given something in return.
Ah, is that the case? So humans are particular about such things... Alright. I shall permit him to scratch my ears.
Uh, Paimon doesn't think that's enough...
Is it not? Hmm, then perhaps I should give him something to eat.

dialogue.sit: I think what he wants is Mora...

dialogue.t: Mora? Are these things not for shoving inside the Offering Box? How strange. To think that humans were concerned about such things.

dialogue.sit: Well, a salary is very important, actually.

dialogue.t: Mmph. I will trust your words on account of the aid you've provided so far. I will speak to the stone human when we return.
However, the stone human is no longer going donk-donk-donk. He seems to be carrying a short wooden pole, who knows what for...
A wooden pole? Isn't statue-carving done with a hammer, a chisel, and stuff like that?

dialogue.sit: Did his tools break or something...

dialogue.t: Oh brother. Come on then, {NICKNAME}, let's go find Mr. Ooshima. Sounds like he needs some help!
A "celery" is important to humans. I will remember that.
*sigh* How am I supposed to work without a hammer or chisel...
Oh, it's you. Well... I was careless. I didn't check my tools properly when we came here, so just as I was getting engrossed in my work, I broke my hammer and chisel by mistake...
I'd like to return to Narukami Island to buy some more, but...
How do I put this... I guess I'm just more used to finishing work like this in one go, you know?
My tools might be broken, but I can still do some measurements and figure out how I want to continue carving.
If I left now and went to Narukami Island to get some tools, I'd probably have to re-acquaint myself with the "feel" of this carving...
Also, this stone's composition is very hard. If we were to use ordinary tools, they would break pretty quickly.
Hmm, you know what...
Traveler, could you help me find 3 Iron Chunks?
I plan on making some tools personally, ones suited to the task.

dialogue.sit: You're going to forge them yourself?

dialogue.t: Great! It's up to you, then.
Hey there, have you secured the 3 Iron Chunks?
Wonderful! These will do, I think.
I'll go find a suitable place outside to set a furnace up, and then I'll start making my tools.
Just let the Lady Priestess know, would you? I'll be packing up over here.
Meow meow meow. Is something the matter? Not to worry, I will prepare an adequate "celery."

dialogue.sit: How much is it going to be?

dialogue.t: Uh, never mind. Basically, the stone human... Mr. Ooshima's tools are broken, but we gave him the materials he needs to repair 'em, so there shouldn't be any problem!
Mm? Problems, you say?

dialogue.sit: No, there aren't any issues. Things are going well.

dialogue.t: That is good. I look forward to seeing that stone, yes.
Hibiki said that once the stone in my likeness was made, some good thing might happen.
Ah, I am filled with expectation! What sort of good thing might happen? Perhaps Hibiki may even return...

quests.description: Neko, “Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine,” seems to have business with you…
